description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface for configuring menu screens related to projects within the OrangeHRM Time plugin module.

classes.name: ProjectMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for project-related screens within the Time plugin, overriding the screen to 'viewProjects'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu for the screen, overriding it to show 'viewProjects'.
